verdict.rationale: The pack documents no first-party Gmail feature for importing mail history or contacts from another provider or client. The only related item is the Gmail API guide listing "Migração de conta de e-mail" (email account migration) as a use case, which is a developer building block rather than a user-facing import capability. Nothing in the evidence covers contact import at all.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client
